title: Woman in Apron Outside Brick House, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white vintage snapshot depicting a woman standing in a grassy yard in front of a large brick house. She is wearing a floral patterned dress paired with a light-colored apron, reflecting typical mid-20th-century homemaker attire. The brick house behind her features gabled roofs, basement windows, and a roof-mounted antenna, characteristic of rural or suburban American architecture in the 1950s.
